headline:
Bulls expect a rebound
earnings haven't shown yet
chart_note: 10-day range: $103.95 - $111.25, up 3.5% over the window after a mid-period peak.
why_today: Down slightly today, up 3.5% over the 10-day window - quarterly earnings actually fell 48% YoY, though the forward P/E of 14.3x prices in a real recovery.
pro_1: Analyst sentiment very positive (28 Buy/Strong Buy vs. 2 Hold, 1 Sell) - forward P/E well below trailing P/E suggests expected earnings recovery
pro_2: Revenue still growing modestly (+6.8% YoY) even through the earnings decline
con_1: Quarterly earnings fell 48% YoY - a real, current weakness, not just a valuation quirk
con_2: Thin 8.7% profit margin and a rich PEG ratio of 2.65 leave little room for the recovery to disappoint
